mechanism_narrative: PARKS has risen monotonically from -21.0 to -9.4 across the four snapshots, showing outdoor discretionary trips recovering ahead of indoor ones; the same households re-enter discretionary retail within two weeks, lifting RETAIL_REC above the -16.6 trailing four-week mean. The parks-to-retail lead is the mechanism, not general reopening.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days is at or below the last-28-day mean of -16.6 while PARKS continues to rise or stays above -12.
